backend.note: The maintained runtime port body follows the #50 implementation pattern: neutral Model in, framework-specific operations out. No framework name, consumer application name, host path, or credential appears in any public artifact.

operations.port: local completion transaction with optimistic version precondition
private worklog create under author and tenant policy
private worklog edit; published snapshots unaffected
deduplicated outbox row plus after-commit enqueue
service-worker external call with typed outcome and reconciliation state
explicit opt-in draft under tenant and workspace policy
draft edit invalidating any bound approval
canonical sanitized preview bytes under the shared rendering policy
approval binding of preview revision, digest, tenant, destination, authority, policy revision
fresh-approval gate, atomic snapshot append plus visibility update, separate publish-output
authorized withdrawal with audit append and delayed-worker refusal
public read restricted to the snapshot allowlist through the public DTO

provisioning.acceptance: native runtime tests are a separate pinned toolchain job; missing dependencies fail required acceptance rather than silently skipping
